IDLE_AWAY.TITLE: Idle auto-away
IDLE_AWAY.NOTE: Ask agents who have been inactive whether they are still there, and set them to Away with the chosen reason if they do not respond. Their open chats are requeued.

REASON.LABEL: Reason used
REASON.HELP: Shown as the Away reason when an agent is set to Away automatically.

IDLE_AWAY.VALIDATION: Enter a number of minutes between 1 and 240 and select a reason.

API.ERROR: Could not update the idle auto-away settings

PROMPT.TITLE: Still there?
PROMPT.COUNTDOWN: You'll be set to Away in {seconds}s
